description: This file contains a class definition for managing address format data within the Opencart admin localisation module. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving address format records from the database.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: Represents the model class for managing address format entries, allowing CRUD operations on address formats stored in the database.

methods.name: addAddressFormat
methods.description: Inserts a new address format record into the database with provided data and returns the new record's ID.

methods.name: editAddressFormat
methods.description: Updates an existing address format identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteAddressFormat
methods.description: Deletes an address format record from the database based on its ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific address format by its ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormats
methods.description: Returns a list of all address formats, possibly with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAddressFormats
methods.description: Returns the total count of address format records.
